component.name: Quillwright
component.summary: Write long-form text in plain Markdown, alongside AI agents

description.p: Quillwright is a quiet, book-like writing environment for novels and other long documents. A project is an ordinary folder of Markdown files: one per chapter, one per character, and a page of world rules. There is no database and no lock-in.

It is designed to run next to AI agents that edit the same folder. Changes made on disk appear in the editor as they happen, and your unsaved text is never overwritten. The assistant panel uses the AI tool you already have installed, and its suggestions are shown as a diff that you accept or reject.

ul.li: Live Markdown styling on a page, with Paper, Sepia, and Night themes and a focus mode
Chapters, character sheets, outline, word counts, and session goals
Autosave and version history kept outside the project folder
Research files beside the page: PDFs, images, and notes, with search inside PDFs
Export to Word, EPUB, PDF, OpenDocument, and HTML, built in and offline
Project templates for novels and for legal cases, in English and Portuguese

description.p: The assistant runs a program installed on your computer, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Ollama, which handles its own sign-in. Quillwright stores no API keys and sends nothing on its own.

screenshot.caption: A chapter on the page, with the manuscript sidebar (Paper theme)

description.p: Research files (PDFs, images, notes) open in a reference panel beside the page, with search inside PDFs, and passages can be sent to the assistant with their source. Project-wide search, a project template for legal cases in English and Portuguese, and a theme that follows the system's light or dark mode.
Spell checking as you write, with suggestions on right-click and a plain-text project dictionary. Each book is checked in its own language.
Updated interface toolkit, with better text rendering and many fixes to text input and window handling.
Export to Word, EPUB, PDF, OpenDocument, and HTML is now built in and works offline, with new language and page size options.
